card.name: Territory changes between countries in history
card.fires_on: Verbs and linking words in European history passages about borders changing hands, such as occupied, annexed to, incorporated into, gave back territory from. Also fires inside 'propaganda' in a German title.

modes.label: Territory transfer wording
modes.description: Verbs or small linking words describing land being occupied, annexed, awarded or incorporated.
modes.example: In 1947, Lipica was annexed<< to>> Yugoslavia and incorporated into Slovenia as a constituent

modes.label: Occupation verb
modes.description: The verb occupied with a country as subject and a region as target.

modes.label: Inside propaganda
modes.description: The middle of the word propaganda in a German publication title.

card.writes: It suppresses settle/settlement words, so it steers away from settlement wording after border-change verbs.
card.plain: It lights up in history text about countries taking, annexing or being given territory.
